children: Ben Anderson Sr, an officer serving as Senior VP & CIO, reported direct sales of common stock on seven dates in August 2026. The seven transactions sold 7,000 shares at prices ranging from $221.21 to $237.18, with a weighted average price of $227.57 per share. The total sale proceeds reported were $1,593,000. Following the reported transactions the reporter directly owned 15,636 shares of common stock.
